method.app: Desktop 0.9.7 installed renderer in a visible isolated Electron 45.2.1 harness, 1400x860 window. Local replay of published 海外 O 端 v4.0.1 with original four pinned library sources. AppShell from overseas v3.2.0. No user project writes. The overview and Page tests ran sequentially in separate processes.
method.factors: on: both enabled, badgeOff: pause only .ant-badge-status-dot.ant-badge-status-processing::after, clockOff: cancel only the AppShell LocalClock interval, bothOff: disable both. Only the one timer callback site in the in-memory test copy was instrumented. Resume preserves the initial per-instance timer phase. Clock DOM and badge remain present. End of every timed window checked for expected paused/running badge states, timer count, advancing/frozen time text and callback count.
method.order: Each condition once per round for 4 rounds in a balanced crossover order. All measurements begin after initial mount and a 64-step zoom warm-up. Each mode settles for 1.7 s (overview) or 1.4 s (Page). One run per scope with 4 repeated measurements per condition.
method.cpu: App process family only, Electron cumulative CPU seconds per PID divided by elapsed wall time. 100% = one logical core. GPU-process column is CPU time of the GPU process. Idle sample 8 s on overview and 5 s on single Page. OS WindowServer and external processes excluded.
method.zoom: 80 calls to the real Studio viewport scaleAtMidPt per sequence, scale beginning at the recorded initial value, rising sinusoidally to 1.55x and returning. Intervals measured between requestAnimationFrame callbacks, no screen-presentation timing; not physical-wheel input. Reported p95 is the median of each run’s nearest-rank p95.
method.bounds: Results are specific to settled editor states, and do not measure startup or export.

overviewSteadyIdle.method: Independent fresh process, same 17-board editor and balanced order, no zoom or gestures during the entire process. After initial settle, 1.7 s settle between switching and each 10 s CPU window. Same verified checks for 17 time displays and 6 badge states.
